### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm64/boot/dts/amlogic/meson-sm1-khadas-vim3l.dts`**
   - The block of code defining the `&sd_emmc_a` node has been moved from a commented section to an active section of the device tree source (DTS) file.
   - The `&sd_emmc_a` node now includes the property `sd-uhs-sdr50`, which is necessary for loading the Wi-Fi firmware on the Khadas VIM3L.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug related to the Wi-Fi functionality on the Khadas VIM3L. By moving the `&sd_emmc_a` node definition out of the commented area and into the active configuration, it ensures that the `sd-uhs-sdr50` option is recognized and applied. This change is crucial for the proper initialization of the Wi-Fi chip, as indicated by the error messages in the log that were previously encountered when the node was commented out. The fix is directly related to the failure of the Wi-Fi firmware to load, which was causing the device to not recognize the Wi-Fi chip correctly.

arm64: dts: meson: fix broken wifi node for Khadas VIM3L

Signed-off-by: Kevin Hilman <khilman@baylibre.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210129085041.1408540-1-art@khadas.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the `&sd_emmc_a` node being commented out in the device tree source file, which prevented the `sd-uhs-sdr50` option from being applied. This option is necessary for the proper loading of the Wi-Fi firmware on the Khadas VIM3L, leading to failures in recognizing the Wi-Fi chip and subsequent error messages during initialization.
